nodes.name: Dockerfile
nodes.summary: Shared Dockerfile for all damai microservices: packages a Maven-built Spring Boot jar onto an Eclipse Temurin 17 JRE base image with configurable JVM heap and a java -jar entrypoint.
nodes.languageNotes: Single-stage build; the jar path is parameterized via ARG JAR_FILE=target/*.jar so the same Dockerfile is reused by every service build context in docker-compose.yml.

nodes.name: eclipse-temurin
nodes.summary: Image stage based on eclipse-temurin:17-jre that copies the service jar to /app/app.jar, sets JAVA_OPTS (-Xms256m -Xmx512m), and starts the app via sh -c java -jar.
